labels: A braid lies close to the scalp, with side sections joining along its length and the outer sections crossing over toward its center.; 땋은 머리가 두피 가까이 놓이고 양옆 머리 묶음이 길이를 따라 합류하며 바깥 묶음이 중앙 위로 교차한다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A braid lies close to the scalp, with side sections joining along its length and the outer sections crossing over toward its center.
aliases: 프렌치 브레이드의 표면
